## Observation and source

Link the review, primary source or reproducible problem. Include date and distinguish observed facts, simulated scenarios and interpretation.

## Decision and alternatives

Decision ID: DEC-XX. Explain the intended student benefit, alternatives considered and why this choice is appropriate. State uncertainty and revisit conditions; do not invent outcome claims.

## Plan and acceptance

Link the Markdown plan under Revisions and intended release.

- [ ] Define observable acceptance criteria before implementation.
- [ ] Link the implementation commit/PR with this issue number in its message.
- [ ] Record relevant production checks and browser evidence; measure viewport dimensions for responsive checks.
- [ ] Record limitations, or create a linked follow-up without claiming completion.
- [ ] Link successful deployment, public URL and release record before closure.

## Implementation and verification

Add exact commit/file links, check results, screenshot evidence, deployment run and public verification here or in issue comments as work proceeds.
